description: Owera Super Intelligence is an AI attendant that Owera sets up and runs for small businesses. It answers your customer, confirms the time and hands off to your team when a person is needed. Day 1: web chat. WhatsApp only if agreed on the setup call; not included by default. Everything in this video is a fictional clinic. Try the demo: https://owera.si/demo/
script: This is Owera Super Intelligence. It's an AI attendant for small businesses. Owera sets it up and runs it. It answers your customers after hours too. This clinic is a fictional example. It's late at night. A customer asks about Saturday. It replies with the open times. Then it confirms the time with the customer. It logs a pre-booking. Your team gives the final confirmation. This is still the fictional clinic. Now someone asks which medicine to take. It won't give clinical advice. It points them to emergency care if urgent. It hands off to your team instead. It never pretends to be a person. Day one is web chat only. Try the demo in Portuguese. The link is in the description. Subscribe — next Shipping drop.
